name: Inwai Chousho
source:
The main character starts working at a supermarket as a security officer. It is just an easy job, just watching a security monitor all day. One day, he finds there are three beautiful girls who frequently come to the supermarket. He thinks, "Once I bring them into this security officer's room, I can do whatever I want to them...." Like this, his evil desire gradually gets bigger....

[From ErogeShop]
